audit_items.proof_trace: BlobSchedule entries loaded from YAML have no validation that MaxBlobsPerBlock <= MAX_BLOB_COMMITMENTS_PER_BLOCK (4096). While SSZ layer enforces the constant limit, P2P validation uses the schedule value, creating consensus inconsistency between differently-configured nodes.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker supplies malicious config with MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK: 8192 in BlobSchedule. Node accepts blocks with >4096 commitments in P2P validation but rejects in SSZ conversion, causing propagation failures and network divergence.
